children.key: This planet is populated by an alien species that, somehow, look similar to the dragons of human mythology. Even more surprising is that amid the towering dragon alien people are a scattering of humans seemingly unbothered by the aliens as they rush about the spaceport doing their everyday business. Would you like to find someone who can tell you what is going on here?
You approach a human dockworker who is busy chatting and laughing with one of the giant aliens. "Something you need, friend?" he asks.

Hesitantly eyeing the menacingly sized dragon, you nod. Noticing your gaze the alien puts out a huge clawed hand, and after a moment of fear that you're about to be killed, you realize it's offering a fistbump which you quickly return.

They both look at you with strange looks. "Now I don't who you've been listening to, but humans have every right to live in Sheragi space," the man says, "these Sheragi that treat humans awfully are disgraceful."
Despite its alien features the look on the dragon's face is unmistakably one of confusion. "I'm a Sheragi," it says slowly. "How did you not know that?"
"I just came here from human space. I wasn't aware of the Sheragi or that other humans had come here."
"I'm sorry, I thought you would've expected that question, considering the other human visitors here."
"What do you mean visitors?" the man asks. "Most of us live here."
"I assumed you were just visiting from human space the way I am."
"You came from human space?" they both shout in shock. "How?" the man asks.
"I used a quantum keystone, you don't have those?"
"That wormhole is unstable, so how did you survive passing through?" the human questions you.
"I used a quantum keystone. Do you not have those?"
"We don't have quantum keystones anywhere. If that's how you got here you should hold onto it, because it may be your only way back." the Sheragi says.
"If you don't have quantum keystones, how did other humans get here?"
"Well clearly I'm not the first human to come to Sheragi space, so how did they all get here?"

"All the humans in Eden were born here, descendents from a fleet of refugees 500 years ago." the Sheragi says. "The records indicate that they were fleeing a war against genetically modified humans known as Alphas, and very briefly a wormhole which had always been an unstable cosmic mess stabilized and through it the humans went, unknowingly to Eden," the man says.

You talk for a while longer, not learning much more except that there are a dangerous group of Sheragi to the north who will attack anyone on sight. You thank them both for stopping to talk with you, and the Sheragi responds, "It is no problem. Honour upon you."

values: The Sheragi are a species of towering, dragon-like people, who live in a remote area of space known as Eden. Humans have been living with them since the Alpha Wars and are granted the same rights as any other Sheragi citizen.

name: Stuck in Eden
description: Follow the mysterious voice to <waypoints>.

children.key: As you land on <origin> you get a nagging feeling that something is wrong. To put your mind at ease you decide to check your inventory manifest, at which point you realize your precious Quantum Keystone, your only way home, is gone.

"You are not from this place," a voice says, seemingly from no where. "Come to <waypoints>." And just as suddenly as the voice appeared it was gone, leaving you with only an unconscious thought of where you must go.
As you jump into the system the voice enters your mind once more. "I will place a temporary field of energy around your vessel, and with it you may return to where you came from."
A shimmer of light briefly appears around your ship and the voice fades.
Once you pass through the wormhole the energy field around your ship disappears in another flash of light.

values: Received a Sheragi license allowing me to purchase some of their ships.

children.key: As you're wandering through the spaceport looking for a nice place to relax, a Sheragi in some kind of tactical uniform blocks your path. "Captain <last>, if you wouldn't mind, I'll require you to come with me," he says.
"Good choice," he says, "this way please." You follow him to a very nice looking security station where you are brought to an interrogation room and sat down.

You turn tail and run back the way you came, putting as much distance between you and the foreboding Sheragi. You turn around and see no sign of him pursuing you, what a stroke of luck! The stupid grin you're giving yourself is quickly wiped off your face as the Sheragi plummets out of the sky, landing like a brick wall in front of your face.
You awaken to find you've been sat down at a table in some kind of interrogation room, and the same Sheragi from before stands in front of you.
"Please be quiet," he says calmly. "I'm required to ask you a few questions."
"I am part of the Sheragi military intelligence, and it is my job to keep track of abnormalities that are of potential interest to the government," he says. "You are one such abnormality."

"You are not from Eden," he says. "You are the first visitor from outside of Sheragi space since the first group of humans came here 500 years ago. From what I understand you have done so using something called a Quantum Keystone. Additionally, you did not know about the Sheragi before coming here, so I can only assume that our kin are lost to time. I require that when you leave Sheragi space you do not mention us to anyone."
"It may have unforeseen effects on the Sheragi if others start to encroach on our territory."

"Good," he replies. "Also, perhaps you would call it a bribe, we will give you access to purchase our technology and our ships." After giving you two flat pieces of plastic which have strange designs on them, he escorts you out of the security station, and you are left wondering what that was all about.
With many declarations of how honourable you are, the captain of the <origin> gives you <payment>.
Upon boarding the <origin> you find a large hoard of jewels, easily worth <payment>.
Upon boarding the <origin> you find a large hoard of gold, easily worth <payment>.

description: Help Izkagg, a budding Sheragi warrior, by dueling his ship <npc>.

values: Help Izkagg, a budding Sheragi warrior, by dueling his ship <npc>.

children.key: As you head into the spaceport a young-looking Sheragi approaches you. "Excuse me, I'm trying to find a worthy duel partner to test my skills against in ship combat. Would you mind dueling me?"
"It is common practice for Sheragi to duel in a contest of strength and skill, both parties gain from the experience of the fight," he says.

"That's the spirit," he says, "the name's Izkagg by the way. Now let's get this duel going. Remember, don't destroy my ship if you beat me, just disable it and land back down, I'll make my own way back to the spaceport after the duel."

values: You have landed on <planet>, but you didn't disable Izkagg's ship! Depart and finish the duel.
Duelled a young Sheragi warrior named Izkagg.
